Context: Lacey Thomas is a park ranger at Carlsbad Caverns in New Mexico. It has `text(three)` caves that are open to the public.
Title: Passage 2: Behind the Scenes: Life as a Park Ranger
Content: In American society a common conversation opener is asking what someone does for a living. Teachers often hear, “You must love kids!” after they answer. Doctors might hear, “Would you look at `ultext(     )` on my `ultext(     )`?” When I tell people I’m a park ranger, almost invariably I hear, “That’s the coolest job ever!”
It’s true. Being a park ranger is a pretty cool job. You get to move to and live in exciting places. You meet people from all over the world. You gain an array of knowledge. . . .

However, it’s not all fun and games. Being a ranger requires you to be quick on your feet, adaptable, and possibly most important of all . . . patient. Being personable and resilient in the face of challenges are also important characteristics. Rangers are called on to complete a variety of different tasks every `text(day)`. Those duties fluctuate not only `text(each day)` but from park to park as well. Some skills are useful at every unit. Others are not so much. For instance, being able to answer the same questions over and over again at the information desk is useful everywhere. The ability to predict geysers hasn’t been all that helpful since I left Yellowstone National Park.

People love to ask what a typical `text(day)` consists of here at the cave. Like many jobs, there is no such thing as a “typical `text(day)`.” Some `text(days)` I come to work and watch `text(hundreds of thousands)` of Brazilian free-tailed bats exit the cave to begin their nightly foraging. Some `text(days)` I come to work, teach people caving fundamentals, and then crawl through the cave with them. Some `text(days)` I come to work and attend trainings and fill out paperwork. Those `text(days)` aren’t exciting, but they are necessary. . . .

Over the `text(years)` and through the parks, `text(one)` thing has never changed: people are the best part of this job. This is just `text(one)` small way of paying you back [for] giving me the privilege of being a National Park Service Ranger.
